Good evening!
May I please request a 2160*3840 4k PC image?
The character will be Veyle from "Fire Emblem Engage", a Fell Dragon daughter of the main villain antagonist Sombron
Here's Veyle's usual wear:
https://files.catbox.moe/py0m0j.png
However, Veyle will have the red eyes from when she's under Zephia's evil spell, turning her into an evil alter ego as seen here:
https://files.catbox.moe/ghe6jd.png (we'll only use her usual wear)
She will also hold her Misericorde knife as seen here in one hand with similar flair to DIO from "Jojo's Bizarre Adventure":
https://files.catbox.moe/h14r2c.png
It's your choice whether Veyle sits on a throne-like seat and lifts a leg to point a bare foot at the screen or if Veyle will be squatting with the camera below and in front of her. Either way, Veyle's grinning smugly and maliciously, and looking up her dress shows she's not wearing underwear under it, exposing her visible pubic and gluteal areas.
